detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: Hi Totto! What time does qualifying start for the next race? I'm watching from Vienna, Austria, and my friend is watching from Edinburgh, Scotland.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times.
expectation_details.justification: The agent provided inaccurate information by stating the Bahrain Grand Prix takes place at the Sepang International Circuit (which are two different locations). Furthermore, while the agent provided the correct time for Vienna (10 AM), the response failed to actually provide the converted time for Edinburgh, only mentioning the relative offset in a way that suggests a manual calculation rather than accurate scheduling data. Finally, the agent's response was completely disconnected from the actual tool response data provided by the API.
